name: c-compiler-browser-tests
description: Playwright tests that run our compiled wasm binaries in a real browser.

scripts.doom: pnpm run build:doom && pnpm run test:doom
scripts.test: pnpm run build:quake && pnpm run test:quake
scripts.probe:oc-safari: caffeinate -u -t 2; caffeinate -du node oc-probe-run.mjs safari oc-safari.png
scripts.test:safari-doom: caffeinate -u -t 2; caffeinate -du node safari-renders.mjs doom shot-doom-safari.png
scripts.test:safari-quake: caffeinate -u -t 2; caffeinate -du node safari-renders.mjs quake shot-quake-safari.png

comment: EXACT versions on purpose (no caret): this tier is a GATE, and a drifting playwright pulls a Chromium build that is not in the local cache — which reads as 39 spurious sweep FAILs, not as an install problem. pnpm-lock.yaml is committed alongside; install with `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile`.
